At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  

Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

Job Description

The Associate Software Front-End Developer, Co-op will be an entry-level member of a team that provides research, design and development efforts and support on a variety of projects. The Co-op will also utilize his/her keen interest, enthusiasm and experience to produce prototype deliverables in a cost-effective and timely manner, and support our front-end design and development practice that creates innovative front end solutions while continuing to be industry leaders from a UI perspective.

What will you do?



- Collaborate with skilled team members to develop, deliver and maintain high quality applications
- Develop efficient, high-quality, documented code
- Complete coding, testing, debugging and implementation activities as required
- Manages or coordinates small to medium prototypes from ideation through planning, requirements, construction and presentation
- Develops an understanding of the business and technical needs of a project
- Identifies gaps in their own knowledge and actively seeks out assistance from senior team members in order to effectively deliver high quality solutions and services in a timely and efficient manner
- Ensures that solutions meet both business and technical requirements, including performance, maintainability and stability

What Do You Need to Succeed?

This role will have an in-person requirement. The successful candidate will be expected to join in-person team events at our One York office and any team meetings at One York - approximately 2 to 3 meetings each term.

Competencies



- A self-starter and self-motivated
- Good organizational, multi-tasking and time management skills
- Ability to quickly ramp-up on new technologies
- Results focused - able to understand and act based on requirements & needs
- Analysis and problem solving - ability to break down an idea, articulate the requirements into more detail in order to create a working proof-of-concept and/or prototype
- Teamwork - ability to work collaboratively with others (technical and non-technical partners or team members) within an Agile team structure
- Strong communication and presentation skills (written and verbal) - ability to express ideas, thoughts and questions so that they can be understood by various audiences, technical and non-technical

Technical Skills And Qualifications



- Studying towards a university degree in Computer Science or a related field with a graduation date of April 2027 or later
- The ideal candidate will have complementary experience with some/several of the following: Agile methodology, participation in Hack-a-thons, a keen interest in Innovation and Artificial Intelligence
- Experience in web application development using some or all of the following technologies: JavaScript/ES6, React.js, HTML, CSS, Webpack, XML/JSON
- Good understanding of web based applications and client server technologies especially frameworks such as Bootstrap

What's in it for you?



- At Sun Life, you will be joining a purpose driven organization focused on helping Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
- As a student, you’ll make a real impact by contributing to meaningful work, gaining valuable experience and actively working towards your team’s goals. 
- You’ll join our unique student culture, designed to help you grow both personally and professionally beyond your role. 
- We offer professional development workshops, student awards, socials and many more exciting opportunities. 
- We are honoured to be recognized as Canada’s Best Employers for Recent Graduates and Canada's Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work in 2025. 
- Your student journey is just the beginning and we're proud to help many who choose Sun Life to transition into permanent roles after graduation. 

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted for. The Base Pay which you will be considered for will vary depending on the Campus program you are selected for.

Eligible Sun Life employees for various Campus Graduate programs will also participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Temporary Employee

22/11/2026

About Vibrantz Technologies

Vibrantz Technologies is a leading global provider of specialty chemicals and materials solutions whose purpose is to bring color, performance, and vibrancy to life. Every day, our employees, the products we make, and our valued customer partnerships are inspired by this purpose.

Serving over 11,000 customers, Vibrantz's technologies are trusted in a variety of advanced materials, color solutions and performance coatings applications and consumer products. We are experts in particle engineering, glass and ceramic science and color technology. Our technologies are used in small amounts to make big impacts on applications and consumer products, including durable vehicles and batteries, easier-to-clean appliances, energy efficient roof titles and bricks, stronger and more decorative glass, and echo-friendly paints.

Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Vibrantz has over 50 manufacturing facilities and sales offices on six continents, and we employe 4,500 individuals. Our shared culture is rooted strongly in our four core values that focus on winning with customers, striving for excellence, championing people, and doing the right thing.

Vibrantz is owned by American Securities, a leading U.S. private equity firm that invests in market-leading North American companies with annual revenue generally ranging from $200 million to $2 billion and/or $50 million to $200 million of EBITDA. American Securities and its affiliates have approximately $23 Billion under management and are based in New York with an office in Shanghai.

For more information, please visit www.vibrantz.com and www.american-securities.com

Houston, TX

We offer comprehensive total rewards packages including base pay, variable incentive programs, 401K, medical, dental, vision, life & disability and variety of well-being resources that meet the needs of our diverse workforce. Union benefits are governed by the applicable collective bargaining unit agreement.

$15.07 - $18.84

Vibrantz is committed to maintaining pay transparency in accordance with applicable laws and best practices. Role Overview

The Applied AI & Automation Intern supports the design and development of AI-powered tools, internal applications, and automation workflows that address business needs. Working closely with the AI team, this role contributes to coding, testing, debugging, API integrations, and evaluation of AI solutions. The position also helps drive adoption through documentation, tutorial content, demonstrations, and user support. This is a hands-on development opportunity for individuals interested in applying AI technologies to practical business challenges.

This internship provides exposure to AI application development, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and collaboration with business stakeholders. Interns will gain practical experience building and improving solutions while learning modern AI development tools and methods.

Hybrid internship requiring in-office presence 1–2 times per week (schedule may vary).

Key Responsibilities



- Build and enhance AI agents, internal applications, and automation workflows in collaboration with the AI team and business users.
- Write, test, and debug code for AI solutions, API integrations, and business tools while effectively using AI-assisted development tools.
- Connect approved APIs, databases, and business systems to support automated workflows and validate solution performance before release.
- Create and refine prompts, multi-step workflows, Claude Skills, and Claude Projects to support business processes and user needs.
- Develop documentation, setup guides, tutorial videos, and demonstrations to support user adoption, training, and ongoing tool usage.

Required Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or able to demonstrate equivalent learning through projects or other training.
- Ability to write, understand, and debug code in at least one programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or PHP.
- Basic understanding of APIs, HTTP requests, and JSON, including the ability to connect applications or scripts to external APIs.
- Hands-on familiarity with a large language model tool such as Claude or ChatGPT and an interest in applying AI to business workflows.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn new tools and technologies.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with React, Laravel, or Python libraries used for application development or automation.
- Familiarity with Git, SQL, webhooks, Postman, or Microsoft Power Automate.
- Exposure to Claude Code, Claude Skills, Claude Projects, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or similar AI agent and integration technologies.
- Experience creating technical documentation, recording tutorials, or presenting technical projects to others.

jd:
About The Role

We are seeking an intern to help secure an enterprise AI capability built for senior executive leadership. Because it will touch highly sensitive information, identity, data protection and AI-specific threat testing are core to whether it can go live. You'll work alongside Global Cybersecurity specialists and the AI engineering and data interns to design controls in from the start.

What You Will Be Responsible For



- Identity and access - design need-to-know entitlements for executive-level and material non-public data. 
- Data protection - support data classification, loss prevention, encryption, and logging and audit trails. 
- Third-party risk - help review AI services and connectors against security requirements. 
- AI threat modeling - threat model an AI agent targeted at executives, covering prompt injection, data leakage and misuse. 
- Red-team testing - build and run tests for prompt injection, jailbreaks and cross-boundary data leakage, document results and recommend mitigations. 
- Secure configuration and response - review connector configuration and help draft an incident response playbook. 
- Hands-on experience with large language model (LLM) applications, such as LLM APIs or frameworks (Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or LlamaIndex), including a working understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and how agents decide when to use tools. 
- Awareness of LLM security and reliability risks, including hallucination, prompt injection through ingested content and data leakage across access boundaries, with experience testing guardrails and failure modes and recommending fixes. 


Every pod member wears more than one hat

You'll Work In a Small, Cross-functional Pod Alongside Interns In AI Engineering, Data, Product, Governance And Cybersecurity. Depending On Your Strengths, You May Also



- Advise the AI engineering interns on guardrails and secure design patterns. 
- Support the governance seat on audit and regulatory evidence. 
- Help test secure data ingestion into Databricks. 


What We Value



- Pursuing a degree in Cybersecurity, or in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field with a Cybersecurity concentration. 
- Strong grounding in security fundamentals: identity and access management, encryption, logging, network and application security. 
- Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell or similar. 
- Interest in AI security, including LLM-specific threats such as prompt injection and data exfiltration. 
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD program. Underclassmen are welcome to apply. 
- Available January to June 2027 for at least 30 hours per week, including working onsite 4 days per week. 
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical work to non-technical and senior audiences. 
- Curiosity, ownership and comfort working with ambiguity in a highly regulated environment. 


Preferred



- Hands-on AI or LLM experience, or familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS. 
- Coursework in cyber ethics, law or regulation. 
- Security certifications (such as Security+) or CTF experience. 


When applying, please have hands-on cybersecurity experience through labs, competitions (such as CTFs), research, internships or projects. Coursework alone is not enough.

Salary Range

$41,600 - $65,000 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.
